title: 112 single emergency number
fact_en: In Spain the general number for any emergency (health, accidents, situations of risk) is 112; calls are free from landlines and mobiles and it works across the whole country.
fact_ko: 스페인에서 모든 긴급상황(보건, 사고, 위험 상황)의 일반 신고번호는 112이며, 유선과 휴대전화 모두 무료이고 전국에서 작동한다.
legal_basis: Real Decreto 903/1997 (112 service); Punto de Acceso General, servicios 112
common_misconceptions: 911 is the emergency number in Spain
061 is the single national health-emergency number (it exists only in some regions)
112 is only for the police
Calls to 112 require credit or a SIM card

title: 024 suicide-behaviour helpline
fact_en: The 024 line, promoted by the Ministry of Health, is a national suicide-behaviour helpline that is free, confidential and available 24 hours a day, 365 days a year.
fact_ko: 보건부가 운영하는 024 전화는 전국 자살행동 상담전화로, 무료이며 비밀이 보장되고 연중무휴 24시간 이용할 수 있다.
legal_basis: Ministerio de Sanidad, Línea 024 de atención a la conducta suicida
common_misconceptions: 024 is a paid premium-rate number
It only operates during office hours
It is only for people in immediate danger, not relatives
The national suicide line is 112 only

title: Right of access to the clinical history
fact_en: Under Ley 41/2002 art. 18 a patient has the right to access the documentation of their clinical history and to obtain a copy of the data in it, subject to limited reservations (third-party data, professionals' subjective notes); healthcare centres set the procedure.
fact_ko: Ley 41/2002 제18조에 따라 환자는 진료기록 문서에 접근하고 그 자료의 사본을 받을 권리가 있으며(제3자 정보, 의료진의 주관적 기록 등 제한적 예외), 절차는 의료기관이 정한다.
common_misconceptions: Only a court order allows a patient to see their own record
Relatives always have access to a deceased person's record
The patient may only read it, not get copies
Access must be requested through the Ministry of Health

title: Minimum retention of clinical documentation
fact_en: Healthcare centres must keep clinical documentation for at least five years from the date of discharge of each care process (longer for certain data, e.g. birth-related).
fact_ko: 의료기관은 각 진료 과정의 퇴원(종료)일로부터 최소 5년간 임상 문서를 보존해야 한다(출생 관련 자료 등은 더 길다).
common_misconceptions: Records must be destroyed after one year
Ten years is the national minimum
Retention is only 3 years like tax records
Records are deleted when the patient asks

title: Advance directives (instrucciones previas)
fact_en: Through a document of advance directives (instrucciones previas), an adult who is capable and free can state in advance their wishes about care and treatment for when they can no longer express them personally.
fact_ko: 성인이면서 능력이 있고 자유로운 사람은 사전의료지시서(instrucciones previas)를 통해, 스스로 의사를 표현할 수 없게 될 때를 대비해 치료와 돌봄에 관한 의사를 미리 밝힐 수 있다.
common_misconceptions: Only people over 65 can make one
A notary is mandatory
Relatives can override it without limits
It only covers organ donation

title: Deposit guarantee EUR 100,000
fact_en: The Fondo de Garantía de Depósitos (FGD) generally guarantees up to EUR 100,000 per holder and per institution if a member institution cannot repay its clients.
fact_ko: 예금보장기금(FGD)은 회원 금융기관이 고객에게 상환하지 못할 경우 일반적으로 예금자 및 기관당 최대 10만 유로를 보장한다.
common_misconceptions: EUR 50,000 per account
EUR 100,000 per account (not per holder and institution)
Guarantee applies per bank group, with no limit
Cash at home is also covered

title: Complaint route to Banco de España
fact_en: Before going to the Banco de España you must first complain to the bank's customer service (SAC): it has 15 business days for payment-service matters and one month for other matters (for consumers); if there is no answer or you are unsatisfied you have one year from filing the complaint with the bank to go to the Banco de España.
fact_ko: 은행 감독기관인 스페인은행(Banco de España)에 가기 전에 먼저 은행의 고객서비스(SAC)에 이의를 제기해야 한다. 소비자의 경우 SAC는 결제서비스는 영업일 15일, 그 밖의 사안은 1개월 내에 답해야 하며, 답이 없거나 불만족이면 은행에 제기한 날로부터 1년 안에 스페인은행에 신청할 수 있다.
legal_basis: Orden ECO/734/2004; Ley 10/2025 (financial entities); Banco de España
common_misconceptions: Two months wait for every consumer complaint
Go directly to Banco de España without the bank
Deadline to reach Banco de España is 6 months
Banco de España decisions are binding like a court judgment

title: Refund of unauthorised payments
fact_en: If an unauthorised payment is executed, the payer's payment service provider must refund the amount immediately and in any case by the end of the next business day after it noticed it or was notified, unless it has reasonable grounds to suspect fraud.
fact_ko: 승인되지 않은 결제가 실행되면 지급인의 결제서비스제공자는 이를 알았거나 통지받은 다음 영업일 말까지는 반드시 즉시 환불해야 한다(사기로 의심할 합리적 사유가 있는 경우 제외).
legal_basis: Real Decreto-ley 19/2018, art. 45.1 (art. 46 deals with payer liability)
common_misconceptions: Bank has 30 days to refund
Customer always bears the full loss
Refund only after a court decision
Deadline is 13 months to refund

title: Credit information systems (ASNEF-type files)
fact_en: Debts can be included in common credit information systems only if the principal is at least EUR 50, and data may stay only while the default persists, with a maximum of five years from the due date of the obligation.
fact_ko: 공통 신용정보시스템(ASNEF형)에는 원금이 50유로 이상인 채무만 등재할 수 있고, 불이행이 지속되는 동안에만 보관되며 채무 만기일로부터 최대 5년을 넘을 수 없다.
legal_basis: LOPDGD (LO 3/2018), art. 20.1.d and disposición adicional sexta
common_misconceptions: Any debt, even EUR 5, can be listed
Data stays for 10 years
Data stays even after the debt is paid
Listing needs a court judgment

title: New customer-service law: 15 business days, adaptation by 28/12/2026
fact_en: Ley 10/2025 (in force 28/12/2025) requires customer queries, complaints and incidents to be resolved within a maximum of 15 business days unless sector rules set another period (financial entities keep their own rules); companies have twelve months from entry into force, i.e. until 28 December 2026, to adapt.
fact_ko: Ley 10/2025(2025-12-28 시행)는 문의·불만·사고를 부문별 규정이 다른 기간을 정하지 않는 한 최대 영업일 15일 이내에 해결하도록 하며(금융기관은 자체 규정 적용), 기업은 시행일로부터 12개월, 즉 2026년 12월 28일까지 적응해야 한다.
legal_basis: Ley 10/2025, de 26 de diciembre, art. 17 y disposición transitoria única
recent_change_note: Ley 10/2025 in force since 2025-12-28; the 12-month adaptation period for companies ends 2026-12-28.
common_misconceptions: The new law gives companies 30 days
It took effect only after 2027
It replaces Banco de España complaints
Response deadline is calendar days, not business days

title: Housing lease: tacit extension in five-year blocks from 15/11/2026
fact_en: Royal Decree-law 28/2026 (BOE 7 Oct 2026, in force 15 Nov 2026) amends LAU art. 10 so that, if neither party gives notice (6 months for the landlord, 2 for the tenant) after at least five years (seven if the landlord is a legal person), the housing lease is tacitly and compulsorily extended in successive 5-year (7-year) periods; as a decree-law it remains subject to parliamentary validation.
fact_ko: 2026년 왕령법 28/2026(2026-10-07 관보, 2026-11-15 시행)은 도시임대차법(LAU) 제10조를 개정하여, 최소 5년(임대인이 법인이면 7년) 경과 후 어느 쪽도 통지(임대인 6개월, 임차인 2개월 전)하지 않으면 주택임대차가 5년(7년) 단위로 자동·강제 연장되도록 한다. 왕령법이므로 의회 승인 대상이다.
recent_change_note: RDL 28/2026 published 2026-10-07, enters into force 2026-11-15 (after RDL 27/2026 was repealed by Congress on 2026-09-29).
common_misconceptions: Leases end automatically after 5 years
Extension is only for 3 years (old rule)
The change applies from 7 October 2026
Landlord needs only 30 days' notice

title: Rental deposit (fianza) amount
fact_en: At the signing of a lease, a cash deposit (fianza) equal to one month's rent is mandatory for housing leases and two months for non-housing leases; it is not updated during the first five years (seven if the landlord is a legal person).
fact_ko: 임대차 계약 시 현금 보증금(fianza)은 주택은 월세 1개월분, 비주거용은 2개월분이 의무이며, 처음 5년(임대인이 법인이면 7년) 동안은 갱신(인상)되지 않는다.
common_misconceptions: Two months' rent is the legal housing deposit
Three months (as many landlords ask)
Deposit is optional
Deposit is paid to the tenant's bank

title: Five-year general limitation period
fact_en: Personal actions with no special period expire (prescribe) five years after performance can be demanded; the mortgage action prescribes in twenty years.
fact_ko: 특별 기간이 없는 대인(채권)소송은 이행을 청구할 수 있게 된 때부터 5년 후 시효로 소멸하며, 저당권 소송은 20년이다.
common_misconceptions: Fifteen years (the old rule)
Three years
One year for all consumer claims
Prescription never runs against banks

title: Free legal aid: income thresholds
fact_en: The right to free legal aid (asistencia jurídica gratuita) is recognised to individuals lacking sufficient assets whose gross annual income is at most twice the IPREM (public multiple-effects income indicator) for a person outside a family unit, with higher multiples for family units.
fact_ko: 자산이 충분하지 않은 개인에게 무료 법률구조(asistencia jurídica gratuita)가 인정되며, 가족단위에 속하지 않은 사람은 연 총소득이 IPREM(공적 복수효과 소득지표)의 2배 이하여야 하고 가족단위는 더 높은 배수가 적용된다.
common_misconceptions: Only people with no income qualify
The threshold is the minimum wage (SMI)
Three times IPREM for everyone
Free legal aid covers only criminal cases

title: Legal guarantee of goods: three years
fact_en: The seller is liable for lack of conformity of goods existing at delivery that appears within three years of delivery (two years for digital content or services); for second-hand goods a shorter period of not less than one year may be agreed.
fact_ko: 판매자는 인도 시 존재하고 인도 후 3년 이내(디지털 콘텐츠·서비스는 2년)에 나타난 상품의 부적합에 책임을 지며, 중고품은 1년 이상의 더 짧은 기간을 합의할 수 있다.
common_misconceptions: Two years (the old rule)
Six months with burden of proof on seller
Guarantee is only the manufacturer's 1 year
Second-hand goods have no guarantee at all

title: Registration in the municipal register (padrón)
fact_en: Everyone living in Spain is obliged to register in the padrón of the municipality where they usually reside; those living in several municipalities register only in the one where they live most of the year.
fact_ko: 스페인에 사는 모든 사람은 상시 거주하는 시(municipio)의 주민등록부(Padrón)에 등록할 의무가 있으며, 여러 곳에 사는 경우 1년 중 가장 오래 거주하는 곳에만 등록한다.
common_misconceptions: Only Spanish citizens must register
Registration requires a residence permit
One can register in every municipality where one lives
Registration is voluntary

title: Default maximum time to resolve: three months
fact_en: When the rules of a procedure do not set a maximum period, the express resolution must be notified within three months; periods set by rules cannot exceed six months unless a law (or EU law) says so.
fact_ko: 절차 규정이 최대 기간을 정하지 않은 경우 명시적 결정은 3개월 이내에 통지되어야 하며, 규정이 정하는 기간은 법률(또는 EU법)이 달리 정하지 않는 한 6개월을 넘을 수 없다.
common_misconceptions: One month by default
Six months by default
No deadline exists
Silence always means refusal

title: Deadlines in days count business days
fact_en: Unless a law or EU law says otherwise, administrative deadlines expressed in days are business days, excluding Saturdays, Sundays and public holidays.
fact_ko: 법률이나 EU법이 달리 정하지 않는 한 일 단위로 표시된 행정 기한은 토요일, 일요일, 공휴일을 제외한 영업일(hábiles)이다.
common_misconceptions: Saturdays count as business days
All days are calendar days
Only public holidays are excluded
August is excluded from the count

title: Transparency access request: one month
fact_en: A decision granting or denying access to public information must be notified within a maximum of one month from receipt of the request by the competent body, extendable by another month for volume or complexity.
fact_ko: 공공정보 접근을 허가·거부하는 결정은 담당 기관이 신청을 받은 때부터 최대 1개월 이내에 통지되어야 하며, 분량이나 복잡성이 있으면 1개월 연장될 수 있다.
common_misconceptions: Fifteen days
Three months
No deadline
Extension is up to six months

title: Cl@ve electronic identification
fact_en: Cl@ve is the system to identify yourself electronically before Spanish public administrations without remembering different passwords; you must register in the system before using it.
fact_ko: Cl@ve는 서로 다른 비밀번호를 기억하지 않고 스페인 공공행정기관에 전자적으로 신원을 증명하는 시스템이며, 사용 전에 시스템에 등록해야 한다.
common_misconceptions: Cl@ve is only a bank app
No registration is needed
Cl@ve works only with a DNI chip reader
It is a private service of Correos

title: Compulsory schooling 6 to 16
fact_en: Basic education is compulsory and free and comprises ten years of schooling, regularly between ages six and sixteen; pupils may stay in ordinary regime until eighteen.
fact_ko: 기초교육은 의무·무상이며 10년의 학업으로 구성되어 보통 만 6세에서 16세 사이에 이루어지고, 학생은 18세까지 정규 과정에 머물 권리가 있다.
common_misconceptions: Compulsory from 3 to 18
Compulsory until 14
Compulsory from 5 to 15
Compulsory schooling is optional for foreign children

title: Digital consent age 14
fact_en: A minor's personal data can be processed on the basis of their own consent only if they are over fourteen; for under-14s, processing based on consent is lawful only with consent of the holder of parental authority or guardian.
fact_ko: 미성년자의 개인정보는 14세를 넘은 경우에만 본인 동의로 처리할 수 있으며, 14세 미만은 친권자 또는 후견인의 동의가 있어야 동의 기반 처리가 적법하다.
common_misconceptions: Sixteen (the GDPR default)
Thirteen
Eighteen
No age limit

title: School bullying helpline 900 018 018
fact_en: The Ministry of Education's helpline against school bullying is 900 018 018: free (does not appear on the phone bill), 24 hours a day, 365 days a year, open to pupils, families, school staff and anyone aware of a case; chat and web form are available for people with hearing or speech disabilities.
fact_ko: 교육부의 학교폭력(acoso escolar) 상담전화는 900 018 018로, 무료(통화료 청구서에 표시되지 않음)이고 연중무휴 24시간 운영되며 학생, 가족, 교직원, 사건을 아는 누구나 이용할 수 있고 청각·언어 장애인을 위한 채팅과 웹 양식도 있다.
legal_basis: Ministerio de Educación, Formación Profesional y Deportes, servicio de atención telefónica en casos de maltrato y acoso escolar
common_misconceptions: 024 is the bullying line
112 only
The line works only in school hours
It is a paid number

title: Wellbeing and protection coordinator in every school
fact_en: Every school where minors study, regardless of ownership, must have a Coordinator of wellbeing and protection of pupils (Coordinador/a de bienestar y protección), acting under the head of the school; regional education authorities set requirements and functions.
fact_ko: 미성년자가 다니는 모든 학교는 설립 주체와 관계없이 학교장 감독 아래 활동하는 학생 복지·보호 코디네이터를 두어야 하며, 요건과 기능은 지역 교육당국이 정한다.
common_misconceptions: Only public schools need one
The role belongs to the police
There is no such role in Spain
It is optional for primary schools

title: Scholarships 2026-27: wealth thresholds updated
fact_en: Royal Decree 179/2026 sets income and wealth thresholds and amounts for 2026-27 study grants; the Ministry says the wealth thresholds are updated by an average of 10% (not modified for 15 years) and a basic grant of EUR 300 applies to non-university studies (EUR 350 for Basic Grade vocational cycles).
fact_ko: 왕령 179/2026은 2026-27학년도 장학금의 소득·재산 기준과 금액을 정하며, 교육부는 재산 기준이 평균 10% 상향되고(15년간 미변경) 비대학 과정에는 기본 장학금 300유로(기초 직업과정은 350유로)가 적용된다고 밝혔다.
recent_change_note: RD 179/2026 (BOE 2026-03-12) raised wealth thresholds by about 10% for the 2026-27 convocatorias.
common_misconceptions: Income thresholds were raised 10%
Basic grant is EUR 200
Thresholds unchanged since 2010 for all items
Grants are only for university students
